notes: Flashcards no longer hand you a themed block of words weeks before the lesson that teaches it. In Croatian all twelve months were arriving at lesson 8, while 'Days, months & schedules' is lesson 25, and the clock and calendar words were doing the same. Both now wait for their lesson, and the rest of the deck moves up to fill the gap, so you still get the same number of new words every lesson. Note that the word deck is deliberately larger than the lessons and runs alongside them, so you will still meet useful words before a lesson happens to use them; what has been fixed is a whole theme landing out of order.
